Morning gold through a frost-rimmed deep-set window laying a honey-gold rectangle across the stone floor and illuminating the dust motes rising above an open atlas left face-down.
A hookah-coal smoldering on a carved bone stand at the armchair side-table throwing a firelight-orange thread of haze upward that warms the low beam directly overhead and its hanging herbs.
A hanging ceramic sky-lantern with cut-diamond apertures above the side-table projecting honey-gold diamond-shaped patches across the leather map-case below and the brass clasp on its buckle.
A cavernous stone hearth with deep ember-coals on the study's west wall breathing amber-orange heat across the flagstone apron and the iron trivet legs planted on its surface.
A pulsing wisp-orb tethered above the manuscript shelf in a copper-cage bracket, radiating warm amber-wisp shimmer across the rolled parchment ends and the brass ring clasps beside them.
A dragon-shaped bronze five-arm candelabra on the side-table pouring honey-gold candlelight across an open herbarium folio and the dried-specimen pages pressed flat beneath a glass weight.
Amber dusk through a tall leaded lancet window striping the stone floor with honey-gold bars that warm the knotted rug fringe and the base of a tall iron candle-stand beside the chair.
A smoldering pipe resting in a carved horn cradle on the corner side-table glowing firelight-orange at its ember-tip and threading faint haze across the open ink-stained blotter beneath.
